svg.text: Made larger, it should still all be there
Finding 10 · computed from the constants; the menu laid out by omorfos_core::Menu itself · not run
NOW
A larger scale runs off the screen; larger text is cut
DIRECTION
What does not fit scrolls, wraps or grows
1 The root menu at twice the size, on a screen of 1366 by 768
Run…
Browser
Files
Editor
Terminal
Settings
Stay awake
About omorfos
Lock screen
Sleep
Log out…
Restart…
Shut down…
the screen ends here
The menu is 436 units tall and does not scroll
“Restart…” is 19 of its 32 units below; “Shut down…” wholly so
The arrows still go to them: the keyboard is on a row unseen
At 3 on 1920 by 1080, three rows go; and the welcome card's
buttons, and the lock screen's words run under its buttons
2 A question with its text at 18pt, where it is built for 11
A row is 20 units, whatever the text: 12pt is the most that fits
The tops and tails of letters are cut, and no error is said
What a program would see is one line, cut short: not wrapped
Tooltips, the notice, “About”, the password box: fixed in code
ACCESSIBILITY.md: text “can be set larger, from 6pt to 72pt”
1 The root menu at twice the size, on a screen of 1366 by 768
more above
No taller than its screen, scrolled to the row the keyboard is on
A sign at the end that has more, which is also a place to press
The welcome card and the lock screen laid out in the height given
The grid of programs as many across as fit, not always six
A test for each on a screen 384 units tall
2 A question with its text at 18pt, where it is built for 11
Meet wants to share your
screen
It would see everything on it
until you stop.
Share
Cancel
A row as tall as its text needs: one function, used by all
Words wrap; what is asked is never cut short
One setting for the size of all text, told to programs too
A test for each part at 22pt
(The keyboard on Cancel is finding 14's, drawn here as well)
